62320.name: Enforcer Drive · Re-ATK
62320.SpecificEffects:
When initiating combat, if the target is on the movement path and a part is destroyed, inflicts <buf ID=1009083>[Intimidation]</buf> on the target, lasting <color=#F74848>1</color> turn. Can trigger <color=#F74848>1</color> time per turn.
ST movement type changes to Levitating, enabling it to pass over low obstacles.
When re-attacking, Hit Rate <color=#F74848>+10%</color> and Crit Rate <color=#F74848>+5%</color>.
ST Body HP <color=#F74848>+10%</color> and DMG Dealt <color=#F74848>+5%</color>.
